name: SENTINEL catalogue
description: Inventory, pricing and hockey-season metrics from the gold layer.

elements.title: Inventory value by category
elements.sql: SELECT coalesce(category_name, '(no category)') AS category_name, products, inventory_value FROM sentinel.v_inventory_by_category ORDER BY inventory_value DESC LIMIT 15

elements.title: Products per category
elements.sql: SELECT coalesce(category_name, '(no category)') AS category_name, products FROM sentinel.v_inventory_by_category ORDER BY products DESC LIMIT 20

elements.title: Average price by rating
elements.sql: SELECT toString(rating) AS rating, round(avg(price), 2) AS avg_price, count() AS products FROM sentinel.fct_books WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating

elements.title: Stock status
elements.sql: SELECT if(is_in_stock, 'in stock', 'out of stock') AS status, count() AS products FROM sentinel.fct_books GROUP BY status

elements.title: Average goals for by season
elements.sql: SELECT season_year, round(avg(goals_for), 2) AS avg_goals_for, round(avg(goals_against), 2) AS avg_goals_against FROM sentinel.fct_hockey_season GROUP BY season_year ORDER BY season_year

elements.title: Best win rates
elements.sql: SELECT team_name, round(avg(win_rate_recomputed), 3) AS win_rate, count() AS seasons FROM sentinel.fct_hockey_season WHERE win_rate_recomputed IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_name ORDER BY win_rate DESC LIMIT 15
